framing: Cyclist share of motorist-plus-cyclist deaths by year
can_answer: partly — it compares the relative composition of reported motorist and cyclist deaths, but excludes pedestrian deaths and does not provide exposure-adjusted risk.
metric: Annual cyclist deaths divided by the sum of annual cyclist and motorist deaths, expressed as a percentage.
denominator: For each year, the sum of recorded cyclist and motorist deaths in that year.
population: All crash records in NYC with crash_date in calendar years 2013–2025, contributing their recorded cyclist and motorist death counts.
filters: Keep crash_date years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; no borough filter because the file is NYC crashes.
grouping: Calendar year; the plotted metric is cyclist deaths as a share of cyclist-plus-motorist deaths.
chart_type: Line chart of annual percentage share.
data_check_meaning_and_decisions: The checked population contains 2,132,218 crash rows across 2013–2025. Each of the 13 years has observed dates from Jan 1 through Dec 31; this confirms boundary coverage but not that every record is present. In the selected population, crash_date has 0 missing/impossible/default dates and number_of_motorist_killed and number_of_cyclist_killed each have 0 missing values. Missing dates cannot be assigned to the requested years and are excluded by the year filter; no selected rows are dropped or assigned differently for missing death values. Decision: keep all selected rows and calculate cyclist share using the recorded cyclist and motorist counts. The share excludes pedestrian deaths and is not an exposure-adjusted risk measure.
limitations: The comparison is only the composition of reported cyclist and motorist deaths; it excludes pedestrians and does not measure exposure-adjusted risk. The date range spans each full calendar year's boundaries, but the check cannot establish completeness within those years.
